title: Baseline fairness — is the classical advantage robustness, or chart access?
description: A controlled disentanglement of the rule-based baseline's advantage. The COLREGs rule-based controller follows the Dijkstra-charted channel (its dominant scoring term reads env.plannedPath), whereas the value-based DQN receives only a greedy geometric 'toward-goal' edge flag and no charted-route prior. This study makes chart access an EXPLICIT arm on VesselEnvV3Chart: DRL_no_chart (28-dim obs, as in Studies 2-3), DRL_with_chart (28 + 4 per-slot onPlan flags = 32-dim, giving the learner the SAME charted-route prior the baseline uses), and RuleBased. Only the presence of the chart prior is manipulated; graph, kinematics, degradation, obstacles and metrics are identical. If DRL_with_chart closes the gap to RuleBased, the bottleneck is access to structured navigation priors (an architectural insight), not learning-vs-classical control.
research_question: Does the rule-based baseline's robustness advantage over value-based DRL persist once the DRL agent is given the same charted-route prior the baseline uses?

environment.chart_feature: cfg.chartAware appends one onPlan flag per action slot (1 if that outgoing edge is the next Dijkstra-plan segment); passed through the same sensing/comms pipeline, left un-perturbed by additive noise like the other discrete per-slot flags

seed_policy: SAME 8 seeds per cell (paired). env_seed = 42 + seed. Agent RNG = mulberry32(seed*1000003 + 12345). RuleBased deterministic.

training.note: DRL arms train 130 episodes as in Study 3; RuleBased no training.

evaluation.note: greedy (DRL) / deterministic (RuleBased); fresh draws from the same mission distribution (within-distribution generalization, not a held-out split).

cells_breakdown: 3 arms x 3 conditions x 8 seeds = 72 cells, 30 eval eps each = 2,160 eval episodes

analysis_plan.omnibus: two-way factorial arm(3) x condition(3), y ~ arm*condition + seed, partial eta^2
analysis_plan.primary_contrast: DRL_no_chart vs DRL_with_chart (does the chart prior help?) and DRL_with_chart vs RuleBased (does the gap close?), paired Wilcoxon + Holm, Cohen d_z
analysis_plan.cte_reporting: CTE reported on successful episodes only (audit fix B); success rate reported alongside

scope_notes: Synthesized testbed; the chart prior is the Dijkstra plan already used by the baseline.
This isolates the information-asymmetry confound the reviewer flagged; it does not add a new algorithm.
Deployed web application unaffected; offline research.
